administration.note: Reform UK won the 1 May 2025 all-out election (42 of 76) and runs the Executive. By June 2026 defections cut Reform to 39, restored to 40 by a 7 May 2026 by-election win, so the majority is bare (threshold 39). Leader Cllr Mark Arnull, confirmed through the 18 May 2026 cabinet reshuffle. Composition: Reform 40, Conservative 17, Labour 8, Liberal Democrat 7, Independent 4. Leader of the Opposition: Cllr Daniel Lister (Conservative). A Conservative Group budget proposal featured in the 2026/27 budget setting (final increase trimmed to 4.95%).

mtfs.intervention_status: No current S114/EFS/BVN on its own account, BUT inherited the former Northamptonshire CC legacy (which issued S114s in 2018); interim CE describes finances as 'a significant challenge'. DSG deficit ~GBP 65m by end 2025/26.
mtfs._source: West Northamptonshire 2026/27 Budget + MTFP (docs s26619 + s27380), full Council 26 Feb 2026, pulled and read directly.
